name: codex-mobile-app
description: Control Codex on your Mac from your phone over your local network with a local-first PWA.
author: Asif Arshad

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix packages/server run dev" "npm --prefix packages/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/web run build && npm --prefix packages/server run build
